# Unify Social

> Unify Social is a free mobile app and guide that helps newcomers settle in Canada. It covers the practical first steps (SIN, bank account, health card, driver's licence), money and taxes for newcomers, jobs, resumes and foreign credential recognition, skilled (TEER) jobs and permanent residency, and local community support. Built in Vancouver, with newcomers, for newcomers.

Unify Social helps permanent residents, skilled workers, and international students with practical life in Canada. The website publishes free guides that are checked against official sources (IRCC, CRA, provincial governments, and professional regulators), and each guide shows the month it was last verified. The Unify app turns those steps into one checklist. The app is free on the Apple App Store. Unify Social is operated from Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada.

## Guide hubs
- [TEER categories and jobs list](https://unifysocial.ca/teer): What each TEER category (0 to 5) means, the full NOC 2021 jobs list per category, and which TEER categories qualify for Express Entry and permanent residency.
- [Foreign credential recognition by profession](https://unifysocial.ca/credentials): How internationally trained professionals get licensed in Canada, with the regulator in every province and territory for nurses, doctors, engineers, teachers, accountants, trades, and more.
- [Canadian resume format for newcomers](https://unifysocial.ca/canadian-resume): How to write a Canadian-style resume: what to include, what to leave out, and how to describe foreign education and experience.
- [How to open a bank account in Canada as a newcomer](https://unifysocial.ca/banking): The documents you need, your legal right to a basic account, and the newcomer offers of the major banks compared in one format.
- [Health card waiting period by province](https://unifysocial.ca/health-card): Public health coverage for newcomers in every province and territory: waiting periods, who qualifies, and how to apply.
- [Foreign driver's licence exchange by province](https://unifysocial.ca/drivers-licence): Which foreign licences each province exchanges without a road test, and the steps to follow.

## Popular guides
- [Canada Newcomer Blog](https://unifysocial.ca/blog): Guides on jobs, money, taxes, housing, healthcare, and immigration status for newcomers to Canada.
- [Easiest TEER 3 skilled jobs to transition into for PR](https://unifysocial.ca/blog/the-easiest-skilled-jobs-to-transition-into-teer-3-for-pr-purposes-in-canada): Which TEER 3 occupations are most accessible and how they support permanent residency.
- [The 90% rule for newcomer tax credits](https://unifysocial.ca/blog/when-newcomers-can-claim-full-non-refundable-tax-credits-in-canada-the-90-rule-explained): When newcomers can claim the full Basic Personal Amount and other non-refundable credits.
- [Reporting foreign income as a newcomer](https://unifysocial.ca/blog/reporting-foreign-income-as-a-canadian-newcomer-what-must-you-declare): What worldwide and foreign income newcomers must declare to the CRA.
- [Filing taxes after moving to Canada mid-year](https://unifysocial.ca/blog/how-to-file-taxes-when-you-moved-to-canada-mid-year-split-year-residency): How split-year residency affects a newcomer's first tax return.
- [How to get a SIN in Canada](https://unifysocial.ca/blog/how-to-get-a-sin-number-in-canada-newcomer-guide): How newcomers apply for a Social Insurance Number.
- [BC MSP waiting period](https://unifysocial.ca/blog/bc-msp-wait-period-for-newcomers-how-to-stay-covered-during-the-gap): How to stay covered during British Columbia's health coverage wait.
- [How to build credit in Canada as a newcomer](https://unifysocial.ca/blog/how-to-build-credit-in-canada-as-a-newcomer): How to start a Canadian credit history with no history.
- [Credential recognition step by step](https://unifysocial.ca/blog/credential-recognition-in-canada-a-step-by-step-guide-for-internationally-trained-professionals): The general process for getting foreign credentials recognized.

## Key pages
- [About Unify Social](https://unifysocial.ca/about): Who we are and why we built Unify for newcomers in Canada.
- [Events](https://unifysocial.ca/events): Free workshops, info sessions, and meetups for newcomers, hosted by Unify and our community partners.
- [Partners](https://unifysocial.ca/partners): Settlement organizations and partners in British Columbia.
- [Resources](https://unifysocial.ca/resources): Video guides for newcomers on resumes, cover letters, interviews, budgeting, and more.
- [Contact](https://unifysocial.ca/contact): Get in touch with the Unify Social team.
